{{Quote|What are merit adoptives?''"<br />"''Chiss brought in from outside a Family's bloodlines to enrich or diversify or invigorate. All warriors are made merit adoptives when they're accepted into either the Defense Fleet or the Expansionary Fleet. That's why every warrior wears the color of one of the Families.|[[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] to [[Jorj Car'das]]|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
'''Merit adoptives''' were [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who became part of a [[Chiss family/Legends|Chiss family]] whose bloodline they did not originally belong to. All [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warriors]] were made merit adoptives of a Chiss family when they were accepted into the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] or [[Chiss Defense Fleet]]. The rank would be lost at the end of one's [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|military]] service if that person did not gain the rank of [[Trial-born/Legends|Trial-born]] first<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> by being "born to trial."<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> The [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] [[Rematching/Legends|selected]] merit adoptives in a manner analogously to how the [[Defense Hierarchy]] selected [[Senior officer/Legends|senior]] [[Chiss officer/Legends|officers]] to join their ranks.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
